visual_action: A montage of scenes from the FIFA World Cup 2026 Final Draw. The video opens with FIFA branding. It then shows Donald Trump and other dignitaries on a red carpet surrounded by press. Inside the event, there are musical performances, including a man singing opera. Comedian Kevin Hart and model Heidi Klum are shown on stage. Trump is depicted on stage speaking at a podium and interacting with FIFA President Gianni Infantino next to a large trophy. The core of the montage shows the draw itself, where various officials and celebrity athletes pull slips of paper with country names out of glass bowls. Officials for Canada and Mexico are shown, followed by Donald Trump pulling the slip for the "USA". Other celebrities shown participating include Tom Brady, Shaquille O'Neal, Aaron Judge, and Wayne Gretzky. The montage is intercut with shots of the audience, the World Cup trophy, and a large American flag. The video concludes with the official logo for The White House.
